text:
marta: quick heads-up — quota checks are misattributing traffic for project-bound keys when requests go through the edge router. noticed in last 24h spike in org-level billing.
kevin: ugh. seen that in telemetry too. looks like origin header fallback is picking org id when project claim is missing.
sam: can you paste an example request header? might be a parsing edge.
marta: sure — snippet from the proxy logs:
```
POST /v1/generate
Host: api.redwood.example
Authorization: Bearer sk_org_ABC123
x-origin: project:proj-789
x-tenant: org-42
```
marta: our router currently prefers `Authorization` for attribution and only uses `x-origin` if auth absent. so proxy->billing sees org id and attributes to org quota.
kevin: that explains it. We had a brief design where Authorization wins for safety. but project-bound keys should take precedence for billing/quotas when `x-origin` explicitly present.
dana: important: we can't just flip precedence globally — risk of breaking customers relying on old behavior. need canary and migration window.
sam: agreed. proposal:
- change router heuristic to prefer explicit `x-origin: project:` when present and signed by service key.
- emit `attrib_reason` tag in traces (old: auth_fallback, new: explicit_x_origin)
- add a console dashboard card to surface rows where attribution changed during rollout

kevin: telemetry work — will need a tag on every request and update the attribution pipeline to join on `attrib_reason`. that's a multi-day job.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: router/config-v2 -> canary on edge-3 at 2026-04-01T02:00Z :shipit:
marta: rollout UX idea for console: on the key detail page show "effective attribution" + a small timeline of changes w/ a toggle to force legacy-mode per project for 30 days.
dana: toggle is good for ops teams. but must be discoverable in billing alerts — otherwise they'll be surprised by changes in invoice.
kevin: for canary plan: small % of traffic -> validate that billing attribution delta < 1% and latency impact =< 5ms p50.
sam: also need tests: unit for header parsing, integration for attribution pipeline, and an e2e smoke that checks billing key mapping.
marta: + add a regression alert if we see any spike in `unknown_project` tags post-rollout.
kevin: heads-up: this interacts with delegated SA tokens — if token exchange sets `x-origin` we must validate that token issuer can assert project ownership.
dana: yeah, we need a policy: only allow `x-origin` from trusted issuers (router will validate signature or exchange-chain). otherwise ignore.
sam: I'll sketch the validation flow and a short spec for the router and post it to the doc PR.
marta: thanks. action items:
- kevin -> telemetry tagging + pipeline change (ETA 5d)
- sam -> router header precedence + validation spec + tests (ETA 3d)
- dana -> console toggle design + billing alert wiring (ETA 7d)
- marta -> add regression alert and coordinate canary window (ETA 2d)

kevin: noted. will create a telemetry ticket and link here.
dana: can we also add a tiny note in release notes so customers see attribution policy change? low friction.
marta: yes — include in rollout notes and in console banner during migration.
kevin: also: quantify cost impact for several customers in canary — if any >10% we pause.
ops-bot: canary started: router/config-v2 on edge-3
marta: dropping a short FAQ in the PR about why `x-origin` may be ignored (untrusted issuer) and how to rotate keys if needed.
dana: cool. ping when PRs are up and we'll coordinate a short sync before canary.
kevin: thanks all :thumbsup:
